units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 5:14">Targ. Prov. V, 14</cite> Levita (ed. <he>עֵדְתָא</he>).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:7:5">Y. Gitt. III, 45ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לית צ׳ כוליה וכ׳</he> there is no community altogether rich, none altogether poor.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:15">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>אפשר דתברי צ׳ לבייהו וכ׳</he> perhaps when the congregation break their hearts (humble themselves in prayer), rain will come.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1:10">Y. Sabb. III, 5ᵈ</cite> top <he>בצ׳ הוה מורי וכ׳</he> in public session he decided &c.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:4">Ruth R. to III, 13</cite> (in Hebr. dict.) <he>ולא ידע … בצבורא</he> (some ed. <he>בצִבּוּרָה</he>) he did not know that R. ‘A. had interpreted that verse in a public lecture; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צִיבּוּרַיָּיא</he>, <cite ref="R00295"><he>צִבּ׳</he></cite>. Y. Gitt. l. c. <he>אשאלון לצ׳ פריטין</he> lent money to congregations.
